about:
Hawaii Solar Connection operates from Pāhoa on the island of Hawaii, where it serves as a local point of contact for residential solar energy systems. The company does not publish a founding date or ownership structure in its public materials.

The business focuses on supplying and advising on photovoltaic and storage equipment. Its product lineup includes mounting hardware, and it carries battery systems from Fortress Power — such as the Fortress series, Envy True 12k, eFlex Max 5.4 kWh, and eForce t models covering 9.6 to 153 kWh — as well as SimpliPhi 6.6 kWh batteries, Discover 7.4 kWh units, and Hyundai 410-watt bifacial solar modules. Customers can schedule complimentary consultations to discuss system sizing and component selection.

The primary audience is homeowners in Hawaii exploring renewable energy options. The company positions itself as a guide for those navigating the transition to solar power, emphasizing an easy and informative process. Its website invites visitors to book appointments and fill out contact forms for follow-up.

Hawaii Solar Connection states that its goal is to make the process of adopting green energy easy and informative for its clients, offering a complimentary chat to explore how renewable energy can power their future.
